name: Joist
summary: Estimating, invoicing and payments for contractors, with AI estimate creation in every plan.
differentiator: The cheapest paid route here, with a catch: Basics is $8.34 a month billed annually but allows only 5 documents a month, and unlimited documents start at Pro ($14.17). Change orders and license and insurance display start at Elite ($26.67), and scheduling jobs is the newer Run tier ($58.33 with an introductory discount). The free plan has been discontinued, so the 14-day trial is the only free option.
pricing: Basics $8.34, Pro $14.17, Elite $26.67 and Run $58.33 per month billed annually; Run includes an introductory 30 percent discount. Annual billing gives two months free. All plans include unlimited clients, estimates, invoicing, payments and AI estimate creation. 14-day trial, no card. An AI Receptionist add-on is $49 per month.
category: Quoting and invoicing for small contractors
bestFor: Part-time and full-time solo contractors who want estimates and invoices at the lowest monthly cost.
skipIf: You run a team with bid management needs; this is built for owner-operators.
